chunks: Your Lord is the Knower of those who stray from His path, and He is the Knower of those who are guided.
ai.seo_question: How does God know who is guided or has strayed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of 'Ilm (knowledge) as the basis for ultimate judgment, distinguishing between outward appearance and inner reality. It serves as a reminder for believers to trust in Allah's perfect discernment rather than relying solely on human assessment of piety or deviation. This concept reinforces the theological principle that true guidance is a divine gift, known fully only to the All-Knowing.
